“Delivering our promises has got us where we are today!”

No gimmicks, just the basics done properly.

Jason Kirby Ltd was first founded in 1998 as a one man operation and has grown into a team of fully skilled, City and Guilds qualified painters and decorators. Our tradesmen are vetted and fully insured, and all are expected to maintain a high standard in craftsmanship, punctuality and friendliness.

No gimmicks, just a traditional adherence to the basics of realistic costings, jobs delivered to deadlines, to budgets and, most importantly, to the quality that we know all our customers expect of us.

  • Free professional and detailed quotations with full job specification
  • All our work is guaranteed for your peace of mind
  • Working relationships with many respected interior designers, architects and building contractors
